create_USDCamera: create a USDCamera instance with a USD stage and object name for USD scene export
update_USDCamera: update a USDCamera's position and orientation with a transformation matrix at a given frame
define_USDCamera_prims: define USD camera and transform prims under /World/Camera_Xform_{obj_name}/Camera_{obj_name}
set_USDCamera_attributes: set USD camera focal length, focus distance, horizontal aperture, and clipping range attributes
apply_USDCamera_transform: apply a 4x4 transformation matrix to the USD camera transform op at a specific frame
